name: rdtmd
description: RDTMD technical markup language (.rdtmd): zero-dependency parser from scratch, live preview, native math, charts, nine diagram types, HTML/PDF export.

scripts.test: node test.js && node test-v11.js && node test-ext.js

rdtmd.preserveLineBreaks.description: Preserve source line breaks in paragraphs and blockquotes within the preview. When disabled, consecutive lines are collapsed.

rdtmd.inlineIncludes.description: Embed the content of @include files directly into the preview. When disabled, displays a clickable navigation chip to open the target file. Exports always embed includes.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code color theme.
Warm paper tones, easy on the eyes and good for printing.
rdtmd.theme.description: Color theme of the preview and of HTML exports.

rdtmd.palette.markdownDescription: Colors used by charts and diagrams, as hex values (for example `["#4e9de6", "#e6794e", "#5cc08a"]`). At least two colors are needed; leave empty for the default palette. A block can override it with `@theme`.

rdtmd.syncScroll.description: Keep the editor and the preview scrolled to the same place.

rdtmd.browserPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Chromium-based browser (Edge, Chrome, Chromium, Brave) used by **RDTMD: Export as PDF**. Leave empty to auto-detect.
